faq.q: What is a beauty product video template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made beauty scene. Add your own skincare photo and generate a routine, review or texture clip without filming a creator.

faq.q: Do I need to write prompts to use these templates?
faq.a: No. Pick a beauty style, upload your product photo and generate. Step two can include one short line about the scene if you want.

faq.q: Who are these beauty templates built for?
faq.a: Skincare sellers, beauty teams and agencies that need fresh product clips for social feeds, listings and ads.

faq.q: Can the clip show a routine without a face?
faq.a: Yes. Choose hands, a close-up or a product-only routine when the product should stay the focus.

faq.q: Can I make several skincare scenes from one photo?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the same photo across a routine, review, unboxing or texture scene and generate another angle when needed.

faq.q: Which platforms are beauty clips made for?
faq.a: Use 9:16 clips for TikTok and Reels, or place a square version in a product gallery or feed post.

faq.q: How fast is a beauty video made?
faq.a: A clip is generated in minutes after you start the job, with no studio booking, creator schedule or reshoot.

faq.q: What does a beauty video cost?
faq.a: A 6-, 10-, 15- or 30-second clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits, shown before you run it.

faq.q: Can I use a beauty clip in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your own ads, pages and posts. You remain responsible for claims and disclosures.

visual.overview: A beauty product video ad puts your cleanser, cream or tube inside a routine shoppers recognize, so the product is easier to picture using.

steps.sourceAlt: Matte ivory cleanser pump bottle with a pale sage pump on a clean white background.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the full bottle and pump head visible.
steps.resultAlt: Matte ivory cleanser pump pressed beside a bright sink with white foam on fingertips.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. Beside a bright ceramic sink, an adult hand presses the matte ivory cleanser pump once and catches a small amount of white foam on fingertips. Keep the full bottle upright and clearly visible. Close three-quarter framing with a gentle push-in. Soft morning window light. End with the bottle and foamed fingertips in frame. Sound: a single pump and quiet bathroom room tone; no music.
